newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-American Health EPS raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-American Health EPS raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it raised its earnings estimates on American Health Properties Inc to $2.48 a share from $2.35 for fiscal 1997, and to $2.62 from $2.48 for fiscal 1998.

-- It cited positive effects anticipated from a shelf registration under which the company would issue $200 million of senior, unsecured debt. The major rating agencies have rated the company's senior debt as investment grade.
-- EVEREN raised its price targets on the stock to $28 from $24.50 for the six months, and to $30 from $26.50 for the 18 months.
-- American Health Properties was up 5/8 at 24-1/2.
